items.text: Chargers WR Ladd McConkey dealing with rib injury, day-to-day per HC Jim Harbaugh. Status up in the air vs Raiders; will monitor how he feels this week.
items.implication: Game-time risk; check backups if limited

items.text: Raiders HC Klint Kubiak now considers TE Brock Bowers day-to-day after last week’s meniscus trim. Working hard to return ASAP.
items.why: HC upgrade from prior outlook; short-term issue
items.implication: Possible Week 2 return; Mayer benefited in absence

items.text: Ravens WR Zay Flowers hamstring injury not considered serious; MRI upcoming but day-to-day. Would have returned if playoff game.
items.why: Not serious per sources; playoff-return threshold

items.text: Patriots placing WR A.J. Brown on IR due to high ankle sprain; expected to miss ~6 weeks (at least 4). No surgery needed.
items.why: High ankle confirmed more serious; IR designation
items.implication: Out through at least Week 5; Maye targets redistribute to Doubs/Hollins etc.

items.text: Lions offense incredibly concentrated: Gibbs, Amon-Ra St. Brown, LaPorta, and Jameson Williams accounted for 65 of 70 offensive opportunities (93%). No RB2 usage, WR3 can't earn targets, no TE2 usage.
items.why: 93% opportunity share among top four; eliminates committee noise
items.implication: Start all four with high confidence; fade Lions depth

items.text: Bucky Irving's 22.3 PPR was overstated vs usage (only 8 carries, 21 routes, 7 targets) but he got the only RB carry inside the 10, out-routed Gainwell 21-13, looked extremely healthy. Strong matchup vs CLE next.
items.implication: Trust Irving as lead back; Gainwell secondary

items.text: Colston Loveland disappointing box score but 92% route participation; two almost-plays would change narrative. Buying low everywhere possible.
items.why: Elite route share despite production miss

items.text: Week 1 recap concerns: Loveland (buy anyway), LAC offense, Fannin, London & Pitts, Etienne. Time now for Christian Watson, David Montgomery, Isaiah Likely, and Coke Heads (Coker).
items.why: Usage/role signals post-Week 1 film and stats

items.text: Surprised Travis Etienne didn't dominate more with Alvin Kamara (knee) out: snaps Etienne 53 / Kendre Miller 26 / CJ Donaldson 15; routes 24/5/7; opportunities 18/9/4.
items.implication: Etienne not full dominate; Miller viable handcuff/share
items.opportunity: Split carries/routes even in primary role

items.text: Sunday injuries watching: Zay Flowers (hamstring), Ladd McConkey (chest), Brian Thomas Jr. (shoulder), Kyler Murray (concussion), Chig Okonkwo (hamstring), Dylan Sampson (knee), Ja'Kobi Lane (wrist), Omar Cooper (ankle).
items.why: Post-game exit list for Week 2 monitoring
items.implication: Priority status tracking into practice week

items.text: Weekend report summary: EXPECTED TO PLAY Jeremiyah Love (ankle), Rome Odunze (calf). NOT EXPECTED Alvin Kamara (knee). ACTIVATED Josh Williams (Sean Tucker doubtful). NO NEWS YET Malik Nabers (knee).
items.implication: Love/Odunze startable; Kamara out boosted Etienne share (partial); Nabers resolved active

items.text: Quinshon Judkins only 13 routes on 30 Deshaun Watson dropbacks. Even after Dylan Sampson (knee) exited early, Browns used third-stringer Raheim Sanders for 13 routes.
items.why: Low route share despite backup opportunity

items.text: Malik Nabers active after late decision (~2 hours pre-kick); family didn't travel due to uncertainty. Played through knee concern.
items.implication: Cleared for action; monitor residual knee

items.text: Jeremiyah Love ACTIVE; risk/reward RB2 but wouldn't activate if injury worry. Starting him everywhere. Cardinals caveat remains.
